Presenting Sounds & Visions: Enhance at 10

Happy 10th anniversary to us!

Formed in 2014 by visionary Tetsuya Mizuguchi, Enhance is synonymous with transcendent interactive experiences that blur the line between video games, art, sound, and design. From the pulsing techno space-scapes of Rez Infinite to the expansive, ever—evolving visuals and challenge of Tetris® Effect: Connected and games like Lumines Remastered, and HUMANITY, Enhance occupies a wholly unique place in the culture of interactive entertainment.

To mark the 10 year anniversary, we are collaborating with Cook and Becker and Lost In Cult Records to present SOUNDS & VISIONS: ENHANCE AT 10—a celebration of the sights, sounds, works and stories that have defined the first decade of our company.

Presented here for the first time are the extensive musical archives, in-depth oral histories and future visions of Enhance—brought to life in a limited edition collection.

For 24 hours from noon UTC Saturday to noon UTC Sunday every weekend, the community works together to reach 100% of the Ritual Goal, which will unlock special in-game AVATARS! To participate, all you need to do is play the featured EFFECT MODE in-game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40456889/9dff4069b7b8c9bc1317c988e9a685e8e592e46b.png

The avatars run on a cycle, and there's a lot of them! To celebrate the Steam launch, we're going to be adding an extra little incentive to shake things up. notes.title: Tetris Effect: Connected comes to Steam on August 18th with a 25%-off discount!
notes.content:
Tetris Effect: Connected will be launching on Steam on the 18th of August with a 25% off launch Discount, and a free Digital Deluxe DLC upgrade for a limited time -- alongside the free update to ALL existing platforms on the same day!

Why did it get pushed back from late July?

After such a successful beta with lots of feedback, we realized we would need a little more time to get bugs squashed, and to ultimately deliver a higher quality game. Cross-platform multiplayer with VR is a huge technical challenge, and giving our players the best experience possible is very important to us. So while we know it may be a little annoying -- we think the wait is going to be worth it! 

Digital Deluxe DLC and discount

To celebrate the long-awaited Steam launch, we’re going to be offering a 25% off discount for the first two weeks. You’ll also get the “Digital Deluxe” version alongside the base game at no extra charge!

The Digital Deluxe DLC includes:

- A seven track sampler from Hydelic, including the fan favorite song “Connected (Yours Forever)” (previously only available for a limited time on PS4 and Epic Games as pre-order bonuses)
- Tetris Effect Profile Avatars
